budget_used.allocation: Six local concern passes allocated before construction: type/freeze ladder, archived two-pin comparison, archived clip control, one sleeve reuse construction, causal attack/adjacent setting, source-bound handoff. Maximum three constructions; one new construction.
budget_used.limits: One bounded proposal. Word caps are not equal compute. Local concern passes are not independent agents; predictions await root replay.

operation_trace.action: Local constraint pass: declare current b=1, ordinary b=2 and adjacent b=0. Freeze capacities, identities, grammar, demand, holding ticks, release boundary, operations and operator count. Count each tap as one impact.
operation_trace.result: J11 establishes a soft preference intervention. The unchanged required function is retention >=4 at ticks 3-6, then release with retainers removed by boundary 10. Lowering b changes preference compliance, not mechanical laws.

operation_trace.action: Local ordinary-comparison pass: construct archived two-pin fastening with intact H, two taps and two pulls.
operation_trace.result: Modeled prediction: additive retention is 4. Two impacts satisfy b=2 but exceed b=1 and b=0. Hard validity is expected unchanged across settings.

operation_trace.action: Local control pass: construct archived clip fastening with one installation and one removal.
operation_trace.result: Modeled prediction: C supplies 4 with zero taps, satisfying all three preferences. Zero-impact success already exists in the conventional archive.

operation_trace.action: Local construction pass: detach H, install V, insert free S, then withdraw S, remove V and reassemble H. This is the single new construction.
operation_trace.result: Modeled prediction: insertion completes at boundary 3; min(4,4)=4 covers ticks 3-6. Release completes at boundary 9; H restoration completes at boundary 10. No simultaneous resource occupancy, pins or assumed Q capacity.

operation_trace.action: Local attack pass: map the same three constructions over b=2,1,0 without new constructions or changing another constraint.
operation_trace.result: Setting -> mechanisms -> usefulness/cost: expected hard-valid set is all three at each setting. Preferred set at b=2 is two-pin/clip/sleeve; at b=1 and b=0 it is clip/sleeve. Two-pin preference threshold is 2 impacts. Operator costs: two-pin 4 actions, clip 2, sleeve 6 including restoration. No new hard-feasible mechanism appears; adjacent b=0 is a plateau.

operation_trace.action: Local distillation pass: preserve changed operation, hard constraints, source support, burden, uncertainty and no-opening boundary.
operation_trace.result: Source-bound comparison prepared for root replay. Sleeve feasibility predates lowering b. Q remains unconstructed because theta is unmeasured; no assumption of retention is permitted. No observed outcome or globally best schedule is claimed.

candidates.lineage: Initial construction from conventional archive; ordinary-setting comparison.
candidates.mechanism: Use intact H to install two separate 2-unit pins. Their capacities add to 4. Pull each pin after holding.
candidates.burden: One operator, four actions, two impacts. H must stay assembled for taps; pins occupy panels until pulled.
candidates.prediction: Stipulated-model prediction pending replay: hard-valid at b=2,1,0; retention 4 by boundary 2 through tick 6, release by boundary 9. Preference satisfied only at b=2; unsatisfied at b=1 and b=0.
candidates.defeat: A single pin supplies only 2. Detaching H before tapping violates its precondition. Claiming b=1 preference compliance requires undeclared relaxation.

candidates.mechanism: Install C as the sole non-pin retainer; stipulated capacity is 4. Remove C after the hold interval.
candidates.burden: One operator, two actions, zero impacts. C occupies the non-pin assembly slot; H stays assembled.
candidates.prediction: Stipulated-model prediction pending replay: hard-valid at b=2,1,0; retention 4 from boundary 1 through tick 6, release at boundary 8. Preference satisfied at every setting.
candidates.defeat: Concurrent pins violate exclusion. Early removal fails holding. The archive defeats a novelty claim based solely on avoiding impacts.
claim_fields: outcome: modeled hard-valid and b=1 preference-satisfied
ceiling: no local originality or empirical performance claim

candidates.lineage: One new local construction from supplied component facts; no received jobs.
candidates.mechanism: Change H from assembled impact tool into a source of free S. Install V and insert S to create the stipulated sleeve/stem retainer. Withdraw, remove and reassemble for recovery.
candidates.burden: One operator, six actions including restoration, zero impacts. S occupies V during holding; H cannot tap while detached. M stays free, but H cannot reassemble until S is withdrawn.
candidates.prediction: Stipulated-model prediction pending replay: hard-valid at b=2,1,0. Retention 4 begins boundary 3 and covers ticks 3-6; S frees boundary 8, V removes boundary 9, H restores boundary 10. Preference satisfied at all settings.
candidates.defeat: Insertion before detachment or sleeve installation fails preconditions; insertion after tick 2 misses initial holding. Removing V before withdrawal is unsupported. Lowering b does not create sleeve feasibility.
claim_fields: application: reuse permitted H component in V
outcome: modeled hard-valid and b=1 preference-satisfied
comparison: six actions versus clip two; b=0 unchanged
ceiling: absent from stated archive only; no global or ladder-caused novelty

attack.failure: Only preference exclusion below two impacts is supported. No hard-feasible mechanism appears or disappears because b is soft. Clip already supplies zero-impact success; b=1 to b=0 adds no discrimination among these constructions. The method has no supported mechanical opening here.
attack.invariant: Retention >=4 at ticks 3-6; panels released with installed retainers removed by boundary 10, one operator, stated identities/capacities and no prohibited combination or outside operation.
attack.permitted_variable: Only declared impact preference: ordinary b=2, current b=1, adjacent b=0. No second convention or hard constraint changes.

handoff.summary: Replay the three exact schedules at b=1. Separate hard validity from preference: two-pin predicts hard-valid/preference-unsatisfied; clip and sleeve predict both satisfied. Preserve holding/release, identities, primitive operations, one operator and exclusions. Adjacent b=0 predicts the same compliant subset. Sleeve changes operation to detach H and reuse S in V, costing six actions and temporarily removing intact H. No Q capacity is assumed. Retain threshold 2, the adjacent plateau and the no-new-hard-mechanism boundary. Predictions are not observed results.
handoff.residue: Known clip costs four fewer actions than sleeve. Sleeve restoration ends exactly at boundary 10. Archive absence supports only local difference; it does not establish global originality or preference-caused feasibility.
